verdict.rationale: Resend documents a dedicated send-email API endpoint and positions itself for transactional email. A hands-on community report praises its idiomatic SDKs and the code snippet on its homepage, which points to copy-paste quickstart code. The evidence does not show the request's required fields or that the call returns a message id for tracking, so coverage is only partial. Missing for 10: documented minimal required fields, an evidenced message id in the response, and first-party quickstart code shown verbatim.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a transactional email with one documented API call — minimal required fields, copy-paste quickstart code, and a message id back for tracking

citations.quote: Start sending emails through the Resend Email API.
Send transactional and marketing emails at scale with a simple, modern API.
I have to say I'm impressed at the breadth of their SDK support (even Elixir) and how idiomatic they seem in each language
